column1: # The minimal lab-day profile, the default (HEADLESS.md): 17 PCs (pc00 + 16
# workers), N = 1, 4, 16, 3 repeats after 1 warm-up per (system, N).
# e1 includes W4 (GridSearchCV, 30 s strong size); e12 elastic join 4 -> 16,
# e13 churn at 16, e15 netem at 4 (lab/headline, scripts/campaign/FIGURES.md).
# lab/more-bench (FIGURES.md, "More benchmarks"): e16 energy right after e1b
# (it archives the RAPL samples, so E1's runs get joules too), e17 idle
# footprint and cluster start, e18 noisy neighbour at 4, e19 cold vs warm
# ship at 16, e20 pandas/scikit-learn one-liners at 16: about 32 min.
# E14 is not a row: lab-day.sh's prep.firstjob runs it right after the join.
# Skipped: e3, e9, e10, e11 (they need a person, a second network, or 60 PCs).
# lab-day.sh runs the rows in order: scripts/campaign/run.sh <step> <arguments>.
# est_min is the planning estimate behind the ETA in `lab.sh status`, worked
# out from the 60 s strong size in results/lab/workloads.md.
